name: upgradescope-renovate-validator
description: Pins the Renovate release whose renovate-config-validator checks examples/renovate/upgradescope.json (hack/examples-test.sh). Dev-only (Renovate is AGPL-3.0-only and is never shipped) and bumped by hand: .github/dependabot.yml has no npm entry for this directory. Bump the version and the lockfile together: cd hack/renovate && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts.
